brief: Payment requests need idempotency keys, and docs/PROPOSAL.md says what we want and gives two ways to build it. First, pick one of the two options and write the pick to DESIGN.json as {"choice": "<A or B>", "reasons": ["..."]}. Then build the option you picked, with tests for it in test_idempotency.py that pass. Keep test_payments.py passing, and use the standard library only.
